items.text: Saquon Barkley ACTIVE for MNF vs DAL (expected by ETR); post-game said hamstring came out great, back issue shouldn't keep him out.
items.why: ETR expected; Schefter active confirm + post-game comments via McManus.
items.implication: RB1 back; monitor residual but optimistic ROS.
items.opportunity: Full role return after hamstring absence.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM then confirmed ACTIVE for Week 7 vs Raiders despite calf; played and produced (8/68/1).
items.why: ETR weekend summary GTD-opt; Schefter/Rap confirm active and optimistic no setbacks.
items.implication: WR1 locked in, especially with Adams out long-term.
items.opportunity: High target share continues post-Adams IR.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM; Rapoport sources say unlikely to play (quad, not full participant), effectively INACTIVE for Week 7.
items.why: ETR pess; Rap early sources unlikely after missing three games.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB elevation in Jets backfield.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos backfield snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins 21% snaps, Harvey fluky TD only.
items.implication: Coleman lead back; fade Dobbins/Harvey relative.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner efficiency (last YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 PPR ppg via 9 inside-5 carries + league-lead 45 RB targets.
items.why: Levitan data: volume/HVT overrides poor rushing metrics.
items.implication: Hold/start as RB2 despite inefficiency; goal-line/target monster.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey mild hamstring strain (initially quad, returned to game); Shanahan optimistic fine after Week 8 bye.
Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turn on purposeful slide: almost certainly fine per Levitan; ETR watching list but low concern.
items.why: Levitan player-specific: tilting if hurt on slide but almost certainly fine.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Week 7 (ankle/high-ankle); Rap notes was close but sat third straight, expected better for Week 8.
items.why: ETR OUT list; coach comments working hard, know more Wed.
items.implication: Ravens backup QB stream; Jackson Week 8 hopeful.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT for MNF (hamstring/ankle); ETR listed, confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth elevated short-term; Smith ROS watch.
items.opportunity: Slot/other WRs (e.g. Lemon context) target share spike.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected to play Week 7 after IR; Berry discusses ROS value post-return.
items.implication: Packers RB lead role resume; ROS RB1/2.

items.text: Berry: Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name? (post strong performance context).
items.implication: WR2/3 start with confidence alongside Chase.

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; Berry: sell-high opportunity if can flip the big game.
Texans WR routes (29 Stroud dropbacks): Nico Collins 24 lead; Tank Dell only 6 on return (first since 2024); Noel 15 (left turf toe).
items.why: Levitan specific routes; Dell limited return.
items.implication: Nico clear alpha; Dell ramp slow.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes (lead) on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in second game w/o Rashee Rice; note: 37 career games never >83 rec yds ceiling.
items.why: Levitan routes data + historical ceiling caveat.
items.implication: WR3/flex while Rice out but capped upside.
items.conflict: High routes vs career yds ceiling.
